parakeet: So if we say a God might exist, we have to ask a God in what sense? Do we mean the God of Genesis who walked in gardens and drowned the world in a tantrum? That God falls apart under historical and moral analysis. Do we mean a God who communicates with prophets or written books? Then that God is competing in the arena of evidence and losing.
